verdict.rationale: Mise supports monorepo-style setups via nested mise.toml config files that merge/override per subdirectory, a single lockfile for pinning tool versions (mise-lock.html), and community reports of using it in a 'multi-service polyglot monorepo,' but this is about tool-version and task management, not package-level dependency management. There is no evidence of cross-linked local package dependencies (workspace package linking like npm/yarn/cargo workspaces) — mise doesn't manage application-level dependency graphs between local packages. Missing for 10: workspace package linking, per-package dependency resolution, evidence of shared lockfile covering application dependencies rather than just tool versions.
